evidence_scope.method: Fresh read-only assessment of the eight specified files. No edits, tests, account browsing, credential inspection, .firecrawl inspection, or previous judge reports/scores.
evidence_scope.innovation: The same-total split/merge explanation, explicit alternative replacement and linked audit form a concrete original implementation. Cellpose, StarDist, napari and CellSampler establish substantial prior art. Scientific novelty and comparative superiority are unproven.
evidence_scope.impact: Four reported held-out fields with correct totals but 100 unmatched instances make the problem tangible. Reported 45.8% error capture at a 20% tile budget supports error concentration, not human benefit. Demand, reviewer outcomes, clinical utility and biological generalization remain unestablished.
evidence_scope.execution: Supplied V7 evidence records successful public deployment, matching source trees, core/model-QA workflows and public focus/motion checks. Keyboard and runtime integrity are accepted within the supplied verification scope. These are reported checks, not checks performed here; referenced underlying reports and source implementation were not inspected.
evidence_scope.presentation: The cancellation hook and 74→75→74 demonstration are memorable. The documented journey connects explanation, mask decisions, undo and export. Technical density and some overbroad narration weaken the pitch.
evidence_scope.video: Uploaded and attached, 215 seconds, with processing and anonymous opening-sample decoding verified in supplied evidence. Later full-media retrieval encountered a sign-in challenge. I have neither watched the complete video nor listened to audio; pacing, visual legibility and narration quality remain unassessed.
evidence_scope.simulation: This is one model-family simulation. Three separate contexts do not constitute independent human judges.

weaknesses: The wrapper objection is only partly answered: substantial numerical execution and correction semantics establish implementation depth, but the comparison supplies no demonstrated reason users would choose this workflow over established tools.

The storyboard spends its first minute establishing the problem and mechanism before actual sample review. Long benchmark and implementation passages compete with the simpler judge takeaway: equal counts can conceal different objects.

Narration says 'biological measurement is broken,' 'every automated count,' 'simple boundary noise' and attention is 'needed most.' These exceed the narrower evidence: matching errors and sensitivity hypotheses do not establish biological truth, universal coverage or reviewer priority.

highest_leverage_fix.action: Restructure the Devpost opening into one concise judge walkthrough: inspect the opposing alternatives, confirm 74→75→74, undo and export; immediately distinguish the graph explanation from the measured object-disagreement queue.
highest_leverage_fix.measurable_gate: Within the first 180 words, include all four actions, one explicit sentence acknowledging established segmentation/editing prior art, and a statement that neither alternatives nor queue capture establish human benefit. Preserve existing measurements.

must_fix_before_submission: Resolve the identified narration overstatements through accurate corrections or explicit timestamped qualification beside the video.
Make the 20% metric explicitly a fixed tile-review budget and expected random comparator wherever summarized; prevent interpretation as measured time savings or corrected errors.

Complete and record an authorized end-to-end review of the existing attached video for legibility, narration/caption agreement and playback. Current opening-sample evidence cannot establish complete viewing.

confidence.reason: Strong textual evidence and scoped delivery reports; no direct interaction, underlying benchmark inspection or complete audiovisual review.
